writing:fc:182.hint: 動物の毛やフケが人の体質に悪影響を与えることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:182.question: Fur or feathers can _____ in some people.
writing:fc:182.fullSentence: Fur or feathers can cause allergies and asthma in some people.
writing:fc:182.explanation: アレルギーやぜんそくを引き起こすという意味。

writing:fc:183.hint: 科学と技術が着実に前進していることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:183.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
choices: Advances in science and technology
A law of banning all smoking in public
have to show calories of the food they serve
carry out an execution
writing:fc:183.fullSentence: Advances in science and technology have changed our daily lives.
writing:fc:183.explanation: 科学技術の発達という意味。

writing:fc:184.hint: 限りある電力や資源を無駄なく利用する、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:184.question: It is important to _____ at home.
writing:fc:184.fullSentence: It is important to use energy effectively at home.
writing:fc:184.explanation: エネルギーを効率よく使うという意味。

writing:fc:185.hint: 石油や石炭に代わる別の発電方法を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:185.question: Countries are investing in _____.
writing:fc:185.fullSentence: Countries are investing in alternative sources of energy.
writing:fc:185.explanation: 代替エネルギーという意味。

writing:fc:186.hint: 自然環境をそのままの状態で守り続ける、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:186.question: We should _____ for future generations.
writing:fc:186.fullSentence: We should conserve nature for future generations.
writing:fc:186.explanation: 自然を保護するという意味。

writing:fc:187.hint: 宇宙に関する調査が人類にとって有用であるという主張を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:187.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:187.answer: The exploration of outer space is useful
choices: The exploration of outer space is useful
have yet to achieve equality in the workplace
use a drive through
have better public transportation
writing:fc:187.fullSentence: The exploration of outer space is useful for scientific progress.
writing:fc:187.explanation: 宇宙探査は役に立つという意味。

writing:fc:188.hint: 喫煙が肺の病気と強く関連していることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:188.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:188.answer: has a lot to do with lung cancer
choices: has a lot to do with lung cancer
Japan's declining birthrate is a serious social problem
build more nursery schools
analyze a long and complex passage
writing:fc:188.fullSentence: Smoking has a lot to do with lung cancer.
writing:fc:188.explanation: 喫煙は肺ガンと関係があるという意味。

writing:fc:189.hint: たばこにかかる税金が政府の重要な収入になっていることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:189.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:189.answer: The cigarette tax is a source of revenue
choices: a lot of dubious information
The cigarette tax is a source of revenue
trained to be guide dogs
The trend toward later marriage is growing stronger
writing:fc:189.fullSentence: The cigarette tax is a source of revenue for the government.
writing:fc:189.explanation: たばこ税は歳入源だという意味。

writing:fc:190.hint: 煙草を吸うかどうかは個人が決めることだ、という考えを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:190.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:190.answer: smoking is a matter of choice
choices: a stay-at-home wife
Cigarette butts dirty the streets
smoking is a matter of choice
play a more active role in international affairs
writing:fc:190.fullSentence: Some people believe that smoking is a matter of choice.
writing:fc:190.explanation: 喫煙は選択の問題だという意味。

writing:fc:191.hint: 喫煙者以外の人が煙を吸ってしまう状況を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:191.question: _____ can be harmful to people nearby.
writing:fc:191.fullSentence: Secondhand smoke can be harmful to people nearby.

writing:fc:192.hint: 自分の行動が周りの人に迷惑をかけてしまうことを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:192.question: Talking loudly on the phone can _____.
writing:fc:192.fullSentence: Talking loudly on the phone can cause others trouble.
writing:fc:192.explanation: 人に迷惑をかけるという意味。

writing:fc:193.hint: 公共の場所での喫煙を全面的に禁じる法律ができる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:193.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:193.answer: A law of banning all smoking in public
choices: Japan's declining birthrate is a serious social problem
improve one's listening comprehension ability
commute to work by bike
A law of banning all smoking in public
writing:fc:193.fullSentence: A law of banning all smoking in public was recently passed.
writing:fc:193.explanation: 公共での喫煙を禁止する法律という意味。

writing:fc:194.hint: たばこがやめられなくなる性質があることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:194.question: _____ makes it hard for people to quit.
writing:fc:194.fullSentence: The addictiveness of cigarettes makes it hard for people to quit.
writing:fc:194.explanation: 煙草の依存性という意味。

writing:fc:195.hint: 火の始末をきちんとせず火の元を残してしまうことを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:195.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
choices: forgets to put out cigarettes
spoil a good atmosphere
learn the formulas by heart
Junk food is bad for our health
writing:fc:195.fullSentence: He often forgets to put out cigarettes properly.
writing:fc:195.explanation: 煙草を消し忘れるという意味。

writing:fc:196.hint: ニコチンへの依存がやめられない状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:196.question: _____ makes quitting smoking very difficult.
writing:fc:196.fullSentence: Nicotine dependence makes quitting smoking very difficult.
writing:fc:196.explanation: ニコチン依存症という意味。

writing:fc:197.hint: 喫煙によって周囲に嫌な臭いが広がっていくことを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:197.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:197.answer: produces an unpleasant smell which drifts everywhere
choices: cannot keep up with the others
an internationally-minded person
analyze a long and complex passage
produces an unpleasant smell which drifts everywhere
writing:fc:197.fullSentence: Smoking produces an unpleasant smell which drifts everywhere.
writing:fc:197.explanation: あちこちに漂う不快な臭いという意味。

writing:fc:198.hint: たばこの吸い殻が街の景観を悪くしていることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:198.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
choices: Cigarette butts dirty the streets
allows female workers to take maternity leave
Eating between meals
carry out an execution
writing:fc:198.fullSentence: Cigarette butts dirty the streets in many cities.
writing:fc:198.explanation: 吸い殻が街を汚すという意味。

writing:fc:199.hint: 気持ちの良い場の空気を悪くしてしまうことを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:199.question: Smoking indoors can _____ at a party.
writing:fc:199.fullSentence: Smoking indoors can spoil a good atmosphere at a party.
writing:fc:199.explanation: 良い雰囲気を台無しにするという意味。

writing:fc:200.hint: たばこを吸うことは各人の自由であるという主張を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:200.question: Some smokers insist on _____ in public.
writing:fc:200.fullSentence: Some smokers insist on the right to smoke in public.
writing:fc:200.explanation: 喫煙する権利という意味。

writing:fc:201.hint: 食事の間に軽く食べ物をとる習慣を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:201.question: _____ can lead to weight gain.
writing:fc:201.fullSentence: Eating between meals can lead to weight gain.

writing:fc:202.hint: 朝の食事をとらずに一日を始めることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:202.question: Many students _____ before going to school.
writing:fc:202.fullSentence: Many students skip breakfast before going to school.
writing:fc:202.explanation: 朝食を抜くという意味。

writing:fc:203.hint: 食品を扱う際の衛生管理により病気の発生を防ぐことを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:203.question: Proper storage can _____ in summer.
writing:fc:203.fullSentence: Proper storage can prevent food poisoning in summer.
writing:fc:203.explanation: 食中毒を防ぐという意味。

writing:fc:204.hint: 食べ過ぎなどによって体重が増えることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:204.question: Eating too much fast food can make you _____.
writing:fc:204.fullSentence: Eating too much fast food can make you put on weight.
writing:fc:204.explanation: 体重が増えるという意味。

writing:fc:205.hint: 栄養価の低い食品が体に悪影響を及ぼすという考えを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:205.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:205.answer: Junk food is bad for our health
choices: Junk food is bad for our health
play a more active role in international affairs
improve one's listening comprehension ability
have yet to achieve equality in the workplace
writing:fc:205.fullSentence: Junk food is bad for our health in the long run.
writing:fc:205.explanation: ジャンクフードは健康に悪いという意味。

writing:fc:206.hint: 軽い運動を無理なく続けることを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:206.question: Doctors recommend that people _____ every day.
writing:fc:206.fullSentence: Doctors recommend that people get moderate exercise every day.
writing:fc:206.explanation: 適度な運動をするという意味。
